nina: Bringing up magnet-14B int4 on staging. Quick longctx sweep (4k->24k) shows a reproducible RoPE phase misalignment starting at ~12,288 tokens — replies drop into an off-by-one pattern.

omar: Is this present with fp16 or only int4? Any repro command?

nina: Only int4 so far. Repro: python longctx_check.py --model magnet-14B-int4 --quant int4n --max_ctx 24576 --prompt tests/alpha_chain.txt --dump=kv_map,rot_map

lee: I inspected rot_map at the boundary. The phase index mapping flips sign for indices divisible by 12288 (12k). Looks like a tile_size vs. stride interaction in the quant kernel.

qa-bot: Quick regression numbers attached to CI: continuity_error_rate=int4:0.018, fp16:0.0000, sample_size=300.

omar: Try toggling rotary_scale: fixed vs auto and see if it changes. If fixed avoids it, then mapping math is the culprit.

nina: Fixed rotary_scale removes the misalignment. With rotary_scale=auto it appears.

lee: I'll write a deterministic unit test that simulates index -> phase conversion for token_pos around multiples of 4096 and 12288 to reproduce. If failing, we can patch modulus ordering in quant_stride_map().

omar: Also add a targeted fuzz case for 12287..12289 to nightly. Add operator advisory to avoid int4+rotary_scale=auto on affected clusters.

deploy-bot: ENG-ML-9123 created by nina -> https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/ENG-ML-9123

nina: Assigning to lee for the unit test/patch and omar for QA verification. Will follow up with minimal diff when ready.
